info.title: About MySentinelCircle
info.intro: A mutual safety net: you choose the people you trust and arrange them in circles around you. If something goes wrong, they are alerted, the closest ones first.

what.title: What is it?
summary: A safety net made of the people you trust: your Sentinels.
They are arranged in circles around you, your 1st circle being the closest.
It works both ways: you can also watch over the people who count on you.
details: Your circles can be your family, your work, your neighbours… Your 1st circle is always the first one alerted.
If something worries you, or if someone worries about you, an alert can be raised. If your 1st circle can't resolve the situation, it can ask your other circles for help, one step at a time.
The people you watch over are your companions; you find them on the My Companions page.

how.title: How does it work?
summary: You invite people to be your Sentinels; nobody becomes one without accepting.
Your 1st circle needs at least one Lead, who coordinates during an alert.
A Sentinel without the app can still help: alerts and replies also go by SMS.
details: Without a Lead in your 1st circle, you can't raise an alert yet.
You can move a Sentinel from one circle to another, make them a Lead, or remove them.
You chat with your Sentinels and companions on the Messages page.

alert.title: During an alert
summary: Your 1st circle is notified right away, in the app and by SMS.
The whole app turns red for everyone concerned, so nobody misses it.
A Lead can take the lead and coordinate the others.
details: The 1st circle has its own chat for the alert; it closes when the alert ends and stays readable in History.
If needed, the 1st circle can ask your other circles for help. They only see the question they are asked.
When an alert is over, it moves to History.

privacy.title: Privacy
summary: Only you and your 1st circle see the full details of an alert.
Your profile photo is only visible to the people linked to you.
You decide who can message you.
details: Another circle only sees the question it is asked during an alert.
Your Sentinels only see what they need to watch over you.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings. Your name, phone number, email, photo and circles are erased right away; messages and alert history stay readable by others, signed Deleted account.

security.title: Security
summary: Passwords and SMS codes are never stored as such, only in hashed form.
Sensitive actions ask you to confirm your identity again.
details: After 5 failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked.
Changing your email or phone, or deleting your account, asks you to confirm your identity again.
The number of requests per minute is limited to slow down automated attacks.

paid.gift: You can also offer a year to someone close, or pay for a single alert when it's blocked.

deathNotice.title: Death notice only
deathNotice.text: To prepare the announcement to your Sentinels without a subscription. Already included in the subscription.

locked.alerts: Your free alerts are used up. To raise more alerts, you need the subscription.
locked.groups: Creating a group circle is part of the subscription. Joining someone else's group stays free.
locked.deathNotice: Preparing the death notice is part of the subscription, or can be bought once on its own.
locked.travel: Watch Mode (trip, All Good Check) is part of the subscription.

self.intro: Your free alert is already used. To raise this one:
self.year: Subscribe for a year and raise the alert

other.intro: {{name}} has already used their free alert and has no subscription. To raise this alert:
other.intro_female: {{name}} has already used her free alert and has no subscription. To raise this alert:
other.intro_male: {{name}} has already used his free alert and has no subscription. To raise this alert:
other.year: Offer {{name}} a year of subscription and raise the alert

pill.label: Subscription
pill.groups: Creating a group circle is part of the subscription. Joining someone else's group stays free.
pill.travel: Watch Mode is part of the subscription: travelling or day to day, your 1st circle is told if you give no news at the planned time.
pill.deathNotice: Preparing the death notice is part of the subscription, or can be bought once on its own.
pill.alerts: After your free alert, alerts about you are part of the subscription.

nudge.afterAlert: Your free alert has been used. So your close ones can always be warned, the subscription covers you all year.
nudge.netReady: Your safety net is ready: your 1st circle can carry an alert. With the subscription, it stays active all year, with no limit on alerts.

gift.title: Offer {{name}} a year
gift.text: {{name}} has already used their free alert. By offering them a year of subscription, an alert can always be raised about them.
gift.text_female: {{name}} has already used her free alert. By offering her a year of subscription, an alert can always be raised about her.
gift.text_male: {{name}} has already used his free alert. By offering him a year of subscription, an alert can always be raised about him.

plans.star: Subscription running: an alert can always be raised for this person.

gender.label: How to speak about me
gender.hint: Optional. Used to word the texts your close ones see (e.g. “Can you go and see her?”). Without a choice, texts stay neutral.

dictate.unsupported: This browser can't dictate. On a phone, use the keyboard's microphone; otherwise open the app in Chrome, Edge or Safari.

alertSignal.waiting_one: An alert is waiting for your answer
alertSignal.waiting_other: {{count}} alerts are waiting for your answer

watch.title: Watch Mode
watch.intro: You set checkpoints: at each one, you confirm in the app that all is well. Miss one, and your 1st circle is told.

paused.SUBSCRIPTION: Paused: your subscription has ended. Nothing happens at the planned times until it is renewed.
paused.MANUAL: Paused for now, as you asked.
paused.TRIP: Paused during your trip: the trip's steps are what count.

todo.alertAt: No news by {{at}}: an alert will go off.
todo.alertSent: Alert sent: your 1st circle has been told.
todo.sayAllGood: Confirm to say all is well.
todo.planNext: No step planned: plan the next one.

trip.title: Trip
trip.hint: A check-in at each step of your trip.
trip.endText: Nobody watches over your journey any more: no reminder, no alert. The trip and its logbook go to the history. This is final.
trip.endPeople: The people of your travel circles stay your Sentinels: you will then choose whom to keep.

newTrip.title: New trip
newTrip.name: Trip name
newTrip.withCircle: Create a circle for this trip

step.linkNotUnderstood: This link gives no point on the map. You can also type “46.5, 6.6”.

instructions.label: What to do if the alert goes off?
instructions.tripPlaceholder: E.g. call mountain rescue (112), my car is…
instructions.allGoodPlaceholder: E.g. go to my home: my neighbour on the 2nd floor has a spare key.

see.shareTrip: My 1st circle can see my trip

validate.title: Step {{n}}: {{place}}
validate.planned: Planned {{at}}. No news by {{alertAt}}: your 1st circle is told.
validate.alertRunning: The time has passed and your 1st circle has been told. Confirm to tell them all is well.
validate.elsewhere: I'm somewhere else, but all is well
validate.wherePlaceholder: E.g. we're sleeping at the Peak hut
validate.logbookPlaceholder: A word about the step: weather, how you feel, a change of plan…
validate.lastStep: That was the last step: end the trip
validate.nextStillGood: Is your next step still right?
validate.nothing: There is no step to confirm for now.

allGood.title: All Good Check
allGood.hint: A regular check-in, day to day.
allGood.early: You can confirm from the morning, before the time.
allGood.delay: With no confirmation, we remind you, then alert after
allGood.tripPause: During a trip, the check pauses by itself: the trip's steps are what count.
allGood.stopConfirm: Turn off the All Good Check? Nobody will be told if you give no news.

end.intro: What to do? Your other Sentinels don't change.
end.reserve: Put them in the reserve circle
end.groupsClose: A travel group closes with the trip: its members go to your reserve, or elsewhere if you choose.

alert.callTravelCircle: Call the people travelling with them: {{circles}}. You can also ask them from “Circles”.
alert.thenInstructions: Nobody answers: follow the instructions, in “To know”.
alert.changeTypeHint: If things are more serious, the alert can become a disappearance or an emergency. Everyone sees it in the room.

scan.unsupported: This browser can't use the camera: scan with the phone's camera.
scan.denied: The camera isn't allowed: scan with the phone's camera.
scan.notOurs: This QR code isn't a MySentinelCircle code.
